topic.title: RAG Vector Search Service (rag-service)
topic.shortdesc: Optional standalone vector search service providing semantic topic chunking, term-frequency vector embeddings, and incremental content verification.

section.title: Service Overview
section.p: The rag-service operates as an optional background service on port 4002. It converts DITA AST JSON topic files into clean Markdown chunks along section and heading boundaries (#, ##), computes normalized TF-IDF vector embeddings, and exposes a high-speed semantic search API endpoint.

section.title: Data Ingestion & Currency Pipeline
section.p: To ensure vector search returns current data only, the service performs automated hash checks and active TOC manifest synchronization:

ul.li: AST to Markdown Chunking — Transforms JSON AST nodes into clean Markdown text and splits content along natural section heading boundaries.
SHA-256 Content Hashing — Calculates cryptographic hashes for each topic file. Unchanged topics are skipped instantly during updates; modified topics are re-chunked and re-indexed.
Active TOC Sync & Purging — Verifies active topic paths against toc.json. Topics deleted from disk or removed from the TOC manifest are automatically hard-purged from vector memory.

plentry.pd: Returns server health status, resolved data directory path, total indexed topics, and total vector chunk count.
Accepts JSON payload {"query": "...", "docId": "...", "lang": "...", "topK": 10} and returns ranked semantic search hits.
Triggers an on-demand incremental hash scan and vector re-indexing pass across all documentation sets in DATA_DIR.

section.title: Triggering RAG Index Updates
section.p: RAG re-indexing occurs automatically on service startup and can be triggered on-demand following DITA-OT publishing runs:
section.codeblock: # Trigger on-demand RAG re-indexing via HTTP POST: curl -X POST http://localhost:4002/api/reindex

section.title: Container Deployment & Configuration
section.p: Deploy using Docker Compose or a standalone Docker container:
section.codeblock:
# Launch using Docker Compose: docker compose up -d rag-service
# Or run as a standalone Docker container: docker run -d -p 4002:4002 \ -v /path/to/data:/app/data \ ghcr.io/jason-fox/ast-rag-service:latest

plentry.pd: HTTP port for the Express vector search server (default: 4002).
Directory path containing published documentation sets (default: /app/data).
